items.label: Loomio
items.description: Structured discussion threads with voting (consent, polls, proposals). Popular with co-ops and nonprofits.

items.label: Polis
items.description: AI-assisted opinion mapping that surfaces areas of cross-group agreement. Often used in civic/government contexts.

items.label: Decidim
items.description: Participatory democracy platform with proposals, debates, participatory budgeting, and assemblies.

items.label: Typeform
items.description: Form and survey builder for async preference gathering and community input.

items.label: Google Forms
items.description: Simple, free survey and polling tool but requires Google Account

items.label: Osprey (ROOST)
items.description: Rules engine for real-time event processing and behavioral investigation.

items.label: Coop (ROOST)
items.description: Human review console for content moderation with queue orchestration, reviewer wellness features, and CSAM/NCMEC reporting workflows.
